name: Shrenik Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Shrenik Ltd does Trading and Processing of all kinds of Paper, Pulp, Paper Boards etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SL is a Paper-Trading Company with its operations in Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra. It is a Whole-sale Distributor for Ballarpur Industries Limited, Tamilnadu Newsprint and Papers Limited, Asia Pulp and Paper (Indonesia and China), Shah Pulp and Paper Mills Limited, NR Agarwal Industries Limited, April Fine Paper Trading Pte Ltd (Singapore) and Naini Group.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -53.1% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 99.9% of their holding.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -20.7%
